name: Virtual Epileptic Cohort (VEC)

access.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EBRAINS free access; confirmed in R1)

modalities: Simulated SEEG and source-level activity: spontaneous seizures, stimulation-induced seizures, interictal; region and electrode coordinates; structural connectomes
labels: Ground-truth EZ / propagation zone per virtual patient (the model's own parameters)
outcomes: Resected regions available for 25 real counterparts
caveats: Synthetic: ground truth is the generator's, so agents tuned here can be circular (R2)
Randomised-cohort comparison was on 5 of 30 patients (R2)
checks: R1: EBRAINS card (free access, CC BY 4.0); R2: full text. This round: full-text data lines re-read.
pipeline: Primary sandbox: the only set with true EZ labels, so it is where agents are developed and scored before touching real patients.
key_claim: 30 virtual patients with known EZ, simulated spontaneous and stimulated SEEG seizures, in iEEG-BIDS.

evidence.quote: we generated and evaluated a cohort of 30 virtual epilepsy patients, using patient-specific anatomical and functional data from 30 real drug-resistant epilepsy patients.
Each virtual brain twin contains synthetic spontaneous seizures, stimulated seizures and interictal activity at the whole-brain level and at the SEEG level.
